title: Continue mailbox coverage settlement past an unappliable candidate
outcome: One mailbox's failed coverage application does not prevent independent eligible continuations from settling, within explicit bounded work and unchanged safety fences.
acceptance: A deterministic multiple-mailbox regression shows an unread, hidden or delivered boundary candidate cannot prevent another independently covered continuation from being considered.
Choose and document bounded behavior for append-epoch interference; retain final turn, runtime, head, proof, unread/boundary and append safety revalidation, with no unbounded retry loop.
Add an epoch-specific race control where a direct append commits before wake coalescence, so the append-epoch guard itself prevents removal; run focused coverage tests.
